content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible for an [product_name] expansion module to accept 12V inputs if the base unit is operating with 24V? Looking forward to your advice. [user_name]

There is an [product_name] expansion module designed for 12/24V DC. Its inputs recognize a DC voltage higher than 8.5V as a logical 1, and a DC voltage lower than 5.0V as a logical 0. [product_name] DM8 12/24R, Article Number: [article_no]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about compatibility between the input voltages of a base unit set for 24V and an expansion module designed for 12V. A specific expansion module was identified that supports both 12V and 24V operation, with threshold voltages provided for signal detection. This information confirms the flexibility in input voltages and ensures reliable signal recognition for integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to connect 12V signals to an expansion module, regardless of the base module's 24V supply, and expects clear and reliable detection of input signals.
